title: My Mom Texted Me While She Was Sitting Next to Me #shorts #textstory
description:
She was on the couch with me. So who was texting from the hospital?

Follow for new stories every day.

#scarystory #textstory #creepy #shorts

messages.text: Who is sitting next to you right now?
Yeah lol, I'm on the couch with you
What? I'm still at work, sweetie.
Mom stop. You literally just made me tea.
I've been at the hospital since 6. Double shift.
You. She's smiling at me right now.
Don't look at her. Walk to your room and lock the door.
She just asked who I'm texting.
She said I don't have a friend named Emma.
I'm in my room. Door's locked.
Good. I'm 5 minutes away. Don't open it for anyone.
No. I'm still in the car.

end: Then she knocked again. "Sweetie, open up. It's Mom."
end_say: Then she knocked again. Sweetie, open up. It's Mom.
